description: URL unshortener: expand a short link (bit.ly, t.co and others) to its final destination without loading the page, with every redirect hop's status code and Location, total hops, timing and whether it loops. Each hop is checked before it is requested; redirects to private addresses are reported, not followed. Use to see where a link really goes before opening or sharing it. Example: url=http://github.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: url_unshorten
title: URL unshortener: final destination
